model_output.rationale: All four lines carry OA-18 (exact duplicate). The 837P itself bills 97140 twice (LX1, LX3) and 97110 twice (LX2, LX4) on the same DOS without a distinguishing modifier — duplicate edit fired on the repeated CPT/DOS pairs. Chart note confirms both code pairs were legitimately performed in separate timed blocks. Claim adjudicated (CLP07 present). MB = Medicare Part B FFS: vehicle is clerical-error reopening; frequency 7 is rejected.

root_cause.explanation: OA-18 on all four lines. 97140 billed on LX1 and LX3; 97110 on LX2 and LX4 — same DOS, same GP:KX modifiers, no modifier 76 distinguishing the second instances. Duplicate edit fired on repeated CPT/DOS pairs within the claim.

next_action.detail: File clerical-error reopening with Novitas. Add modifier 76 to LX3 (second 97140) and LX4 (second 97110) — modifier 76 is reopening-eligible on Part B. Frequency 7 is not accepted on Medicare Part B FFS.

evidence.fact: CAS*OA*18 on all four service lines; CLP02=4 (denied); $0 paid; CLP07=2623576767957 confirms adjudication
97140 billed on LX1 (1 unit, $47.76) and LX3 (1 unit, $46.48); 97110 billed on LX2 (2 units) and LX4 (1 unit); all DOS 20260705; no modifier 76 on second instances
Two distinct 97140 timed blocks (15 min, 14 min) and two 97110 blocks (31 min, 16 min) documented for 2026-07-05 — services were legitimately performed
Filing indicator MB (Medicare Part B FFS); clerical-error reopening required for adjudicated Part B claim; frequency 7 rejected on Part B

citations.rule: False duplicate (same CPT, same DOS, no distinguishing modifier) → correct_and_resubmit; Part B FFS: clerical-error reopening, modifier 76 on reopening-eligible list
CARC 18 exact duplicate (OA): true dup → do_not_resubmit; repeat/bilateral service without modifier → correct_and_resubmit
Part B / DME FFS: frequency 7 not accepted; reopening (1 yr) or redetermination (120 days) for adjudicated claims
